name: Syncthing
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Syncthing keeps folders in sync between devices, peer to peer. The egg runs Syncthing with its web interface on the server's port and a login you set, or a private relay or discovery server for your own devices.
startup: case "{{MODE}}" in relay) [ -x strelaysrv ] || { echo "Reinstall the server to download the relay server."; exit 1; }; mkdir -p relay; pools=""; if [ "{{RELAY_PUBLIC}}" = 1 ]; then pools=https://relays.syncthing.net/endpoint; fi; exec ./strelaysrv -listen=:{{SERVER_PORT}} -keys=relay -status-srv= -pools="$pools" ${RELAY_TOKEN:+-token="$RELAY_TOKEN"} ;; discovery) [ -x stdiscosrv ] || { echo "Reinstall the server to download the discovery server."; exit 1; }; mkdir -p discovery; exec ./stdiscosrv --listen=:{{SERVER_PORT}} --db-dir=discovery --cert=discovery/cert.pem --key=discovery/key.pem ;; *) [ -x syncthing ] || { echo "Reinstall the server to download Syncthing."; exit 1; }; if [ -z "${GUI_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then echo "Set GUI password in the server's settings, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; ./syncthing generate --home=config --gui-user="{{GUI_USER}}" --gui-password="$GUI_PASSWORD" --no-port-probing > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Syncthing couldn't write its configuration in the config folder."; exit 1; }; sed -i -e '/<listenAddress>/d' -e "s#^\( *\)<options>#&\n\1    <listenAddress>tcp://:{{SYNC_PORT}}</listenAddress>\n\1    <listenAddress>quic://:{{SYNC_PORT}}</listenAddress>#" config/config.xml; if [ "{{USAGE_REPORTING}}" != 1 ]; then sed -i -e 's#<urAccepted>[^<]*<#<urAccepted>-1<#' -e 's#<crashReportingEnabled>[^<]*<#<crashReportingEnabled>false<#' config/config.xml; fi; STNOUPGRADE=1 exec ./syncthing serve --home=config --no-browser --no-restart --gui-address=http://0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}} ;; esac

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Syncthing: downloads what Run chooses, Syncthing itself (from its GitHub
# releases, checked against GitHub's SHA-256) or its relay or discovery
# server (from Syncthing's apt repository, checked against its index). The
# configuration, keys, database and synced folders are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Syncthing has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac
version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
mode="${MODE:-syncthing}"

case "$mode" in
syncthing)
    bin=syncthing what=Syncthing
    tag=$(gh-release tag syncthing/syncthing "$version") ||
        fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.1.7, then reinstall."
    if [ -x syncthing ] && [ "$(cat .syncthing-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
        echo "Syncthing $tag is already installed."
    else
        echo "Downloading Syncthing $tag."
        gh-release download syncthing/syncthing "$tag" "syncthing-linux-$arch-$tag.tar.gz" "$work/st.tar.gz"
        tar -xzf "$work/st.tar.gz" -C "$work" --strip-components=1 "syncthing-linux-$arch-$tag/syncthing"
        install -m 0755 "$work/syncthing" syncthing.new
        mv -f syncthing.new syncthing
        echo "$tag" > .syncthing-version
    fi
    ;;
relay | discovery)
    if [ "$mode" = relay ]; then pkg=syncthing-relaysrv bin=strelaysrv; else pkg=syncthing-discosrv bin=stdiscosrv; fi
    what="the Syncthing $mode server"
    # The apt repository lists the newest releases with their checksums.
    index=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "https://apt.syncthing.net/dists/syncthing/stable-v2/binary-$arch/Packages") ||
        fail "Syncthing's apt repository can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    entries=$(awk -v p="$pkg" '/^Package:/ { ok = ($2 == p) } ok && /^Version:/ { v = $2 } ok && /^Filename:/ { f = $2 } ok && /^SHA256:/ { print v, f, $2 }' <<<"$index" | sort -V)
    [ -n "$entries" ] || fail "Syncthing's apt repository has no $pkg for this CPU."
    if [ "$version" = latest ]; then
        read -r ver file sum < <(tail -n 1 <<<"$entries")
    else
        read -r ver file sum < <(awk -v v="${version#v}" '$1 == v' <<<"$entries") ||
            fail "The $mode server is only published for Syncthing's newest releases ($(awk '{print $1}' <<<"$entries" | paste -sd, - | sed 's/,/, /g')). Set Version to latest or one of those, then reinstall."
    fi
    tag="v$ver"
    if [ -x "$bin" ] && [ "$(cat ".$bin-version" 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
        echo "The Syncthing $mode server $tag is already installed."
    else
        echo "Downloading the Syncthing $mode server $tag."
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)" -o "$work/pkg.deb" "https://apt.syncthing.net/$file" ||
            fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
        [ "$(sha256sum "$work/pkg.deb" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] ||
            fail "The download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        dpkg-deb -x "$work/pkg.deb" "$work/pkg"
        install -m 0755 "$work/pkg/usr/bin/$bin" "$bin.new"
        mv -f "$bin.new" "$bin"
        echo "$tag" > ".$bin-version"
    fi
    ;;
*) fail "Run must be syncthing, relay or discovery." ;;
esac
echo "Installed $what $tag."

variables.name: Run
variables.description: What to run: syncthing, relay (a relay server) or discovery (a discovery server). Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Syncthing version to install, such as 2.1.7, or latest. The relay and discovery servers are only published for the newest releases. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: GUI username
variables.description: The login name for Syncthing's web interface.

variables.name: GUI password
variables.description: The password for Syncthing's web interface, at least 8 characters. Syncthing won't start without one.

variables.name: Sync port
variables.description: The port devices connect to, over TCP and UDP (QUIC). Add it to the server's ports too.

variables.name: Usage reports
variables.description: Off sends no usage statistics or crash reports to Syncthing's developers. On lets you choose in the web interface.

variables.name: Public relay
variables.description: For the relay server: join Syncthing's public relay pool, so anyone's devices may use it. Off keeps it for devices you point at it.

variables.name: Relay token
variables.description: For the relay server: a token devices must give to use it. Setting one keeps it out of the public pool.
